name: worktrees
description: Gives every agent that can edit a git worktree of its own, runs a project's setup script with its own port range, kills what an agent left running, removes an agent's worktree and branch once the session merges it, and tidies other merged branches on demand with /tidy

readOnlyAgents.title: More read-only agent types
readOnlyAgents.description: Comma-separated agent types that never edit files and so run without a worktree, on top of Explore, Plan, claude-code-guide, statusline-setup, scout and reviewer.

portBase.title: Port base
portBase.description: Worktree slot N owns ports portBase + N*10 through portBase + N*10 + 9. Slots start at 1, so portBase..portBase+9 stay free for the main checkout.
